post.summary: Create a booking: checks room availability, then opens a Stripe Checkout Session for the deposit
post.description: Rejects with 409 if any requested room overlaps an existing non-cancelled booking for the given dates. On success the booking is created with status "pending" and a Stripe payment_url is returned; the booking is only confirmed once the Stripe webhook receives the completed checkout session.

201.description: Booking created, Stripe payment URL returned

409.description: One or more rooms are not available for the requested dates

get.summary: Get a single booking (with user, rooms, guests, actions, payments loaded)

post.summary: Cancel a pending/confirmed booking (refunds via Stripe if 2+ days before check-in)

422.description: Booking can no longer be cancelled

post.summary: Stripe calls this when a checkout session completes; confirms the booking and records the deposit payment
post.description: Verified using the Stripe-Signature header and the configured webhook secret. Not intended to be called manually.
